name: Yunzi Yulong
source:
[i]"I really like travel. That's why I like the freedom of being a courier, it means I can work wherever I want."[/i]

[i]Easygoing Wanderer[/i]

One of the heroine's delivery buddies, who cares about her. He's friendly and approachable, and naturally tends to make others lower their guard. 

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/neonclash/english/characters/]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
